final: WITH album_rates AS (SELECT AlbumId, 1.0 * SUM(Bytes) / SUM(Milliseconds) AS rate, COUNT(*) AS track_count FROM Track GROUP BY AlbumId), mean_rate AS (SELECT AVG(rate) AS value FROM album_rates) SELECT AVG(rate) AS average_rate, AVG(track_count) AS average_track_count, AVG(rate - value) AS average_excess_rate FROM album_rates CROSS JOIN mean_rate WHERE rate > value
